hope: Spend 3 Hope to make a target within Close range temporarily Vulnerable.

features.name: I Am the Weapon
features.short: With no other Active Weapon, you wield Brawler’s Strike as a primary weapon: trait of your choice, Melee range, d8+d6 physical damage (both dice scale with Proficiency). While it is active, +1 Evasion.

features.name: Combo Strike
features.short: After rolling damage on a successful Melee weapon attack, mark a Stress to start a combo strike: roll your Combo Die and keep rolling until a result is lower than the one before. Deal extra damage equal to the total of all results (they can’t be modified). Combo Die starts as a d4; once per tier, increase it one step as a level advancement option.

brawler.juggernaut.name: Rugged
brawler.juggernaut.short: Permanent +3 to your Severe damage threshold.

brawler.juggernaut.name: Overwhelm
brawler.juggernaut.short: On a successful attack, spend a Hope to throw the target (within Close range) or force them to mark a Stress.

brawler.juggernaut.name: Surrounded
brawler.juggernaut.short: When you attack with a Melee weapon, spend any number of Hope to target that many additional creatures within Melee range.

brawler.juggernaut.name: Eye for an Eye
brawler.juggernaut.short: Once per rest, when an adversary within Melee range forces you to mark Hit Points, mark a Stress to force them to mark the same number.

brawler.juggernaut.name: Pummeljoy
brawler.juggernaut.short: On a critical success with a Melee weapon attack: gain a Hope, clear a Stress, and +1 Proficiency for that attack.

brawler.juggernaut.name: Not Done Yet
brawler.juggernaut.short: When you take Severe damage, gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

brawler.martial-artist.name: Stance Fighter
brawler.martial-artist.short: Shift into martial stances for special combat benefits. Take the Martial Stances sheet and choose two Tier 1 stances; each level-up, choose another from your tier or lower.

brawler.martial-artist.name: Keen Defenses
brawler.martial-artist.short: When targeted by an attack, spend a Focus for a bonus to Evasion equal to your tier against it.

brawler.martial-artist.name: Focus Cannon
brawler.martial-artist.short: Spend a Focus to make an Instinct Roll against an adversary within Far range. On a success, deal d20+3 magic damage using your Proficiency.

brawler.martial-artist.name: Limit Breaker
brawler.martial-artist.short: Once per rest, perform an unbelievable athletic feat (run across water, leap between rooftops, scale a building) without rolling; gain a Hope and clear a Stress.

brawler.martial-artist.name: Flow State
brawler.martial-artist.short: Mark a Stress instead of spending a Focus to change stance. Spend a Focus instead of marking a Stress to start a combo strike.

stances.favored: Bonus to damage rolls equal to a trait of your choice.
stances.invigorating: On a successful attack, roll a d4; on a 4, gain a Focus.
stances.quick: When you attack, spend a Focus or mark a Stress to also target another creature in range.
stances.aggressive: -1 Evasion. On a successful attack, roll an additional damage die and drop the lowest.
stances.anchored: +2 to damage thresholds; you can’t be moved against your will.
stances.defensive: Melee-range attacks against you have disadvantage unless the attacker marks a Stress.
stances.otherworldly: On a successful attack, deal physical or magic damage.
stances.grappling: On a successful Melee-range attack, spend a Focus or mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target or throw it up to Close range.
stances.scary: On a successful attack, the target marks a Stress.
stances.stable: Spend a Focus instead of an Armor Slot to reduce damage.
stances.vigilant: When targeted by an attack, mark a Stress for a d6 bonus to Evasion against it.
stances.crushing: On Severe damage, spend a Hope to force the target to mark an additional Hit Point.
stances.exacting: A 1 on a damage die counts as the die’s highest value.
stances.honed: Spend a Focus before an attack roll for +1 Proficiency on that attack.
stances.isolating: Advantage on attack rolls when no other creatures are within Very Close range of you or your target.
